question: Which company agreed to acquire Kard?

hits.title: Citi expands customer engagement and Commerce media capabilities with addition of Kard.
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2026-08-13] Citi Group acquired Kard Financial, Inc. on Aug 13th '26. NEW YORK - Citi's U.S. Consumer Cards business today announced that it has entered into an agreement to acquire Kard Financial, Inc. (Kard), a company that operates a commerce media and rewards platform that helps banks and fintechs deepen customer engagement through personalized offers.
hits.summary: Citi Group acquired Kard Financial, Inc. on Aug 13th '26.
